capabilities: Render vgl code blocks as styled SVG diagrams in reading view
Support visual-thinking notations such as IBIS, Concept Maps, and Causal Loop Diagrams
Zoom and pinch rendered diagrams, with fit-to-width controls
Open a VGL syntax guide and insert IBIS examples from the command palette
extras: Works fully offline: the rendering engine and Graphviz layout are compiled into a bundled WebAssembly module and the plugin makes no network calls. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid does not cover structured visual-thinking notations like IBIS, Theory of Constraints trees, or causal loop diagrams.

relations.evidence: Graphviz (EPL-2.0) — layout engine, compiled into the WebAssembly module

summary: Diagram renderer that turns vgl code blocks into SVG visual-thinking diagrams (IBIS, Concept Maps, Causal Loop Diagrams, Timelines, and more).
